name: wcag
description: Accessibility auditing, remediation, and rebuilding for web pages, PDFs, office documents, and mobile apps, measured against WCAG 2.2. Works in source code and directly in Office files.

plugins.name: wcag
plugins.description: Audits web pages, PDFs, documents, and mobile apps against WCAG 2.2, fixes what it finds when asked, and rebuilds a document that cannot be repaired. Audit mode never edits anything.
